criteria.criterion: New file .github/workflows/pages.yml (governance change, named here) runs on push to the default branch and workflow_dispatch, builds with `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, and deploys using actions/configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact and deploy-pages, with minimal permissions (contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write) and a concurrency group.
criteria.evidence: Read the diff. Triggers are push to [main] and workflow_dispatch. Permissions are exactly contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write. Concurrency group is `pages`. The build runs `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site`, then configure-pages@v5 and upload-pages-artifact@v3 (path: site). deploy-pages@v4 runs in the github-pages environment.

criteria.criterion: Existing .github/workflows/ci.yml, athena.toml, defaults.toml, rust-toolchain.toml and Cargo lint tables are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: `git diff HEAD~1 --stat` on those files and the root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock printed nothing. In xtask/Cargo.toml only the description line changed.
commands: git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- .github/workflows/ci.yml athena.toml defaults.toml rust-toolchain.toml Cargo.toml Cargo.lock

criteria.criterion: An xtask `site` subcommand renders one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS, viewport meta, responsive layout, prefers-color-scheme dark mode) with text taken from the study JSON and HTML-escaped.
criteria.evidence: xtask/src/site.rs puts the CSS inline in <style>. It has a viewport meta tag, an auto-fit grid, a max-width media query and a prefers-color-scheme:dark block. All study text passes through escape(), and the test text_is_html_escaped covers this. My grep of the generated page found no <script>, <link or external href.

criteria.criterion: Every factual statement on the page cites a claim id from claims.json, and the page states the pinned firstmate commit from pin.json.
criteria.evidence: States, counters, transitions and rationales all go through cites(). It is an error if an element cites no claim or an unknown claim. The claims list repeats each id. The generated page contains 'Pinned firstmate commit: 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827'. Findings are listed under finding ids in a section that says they are about the study itself (minor finding).

criteria.criterion: The output directory is gitignored; the build produces index.html at the site root so the Pages URL serves it.
criteria.evidence: .gitignore adds /site. `ls site` shows index.html, and the workflow uploads path: site.

criteria.criterion: A design note in docs/design records alternatives and deferrals; CHANGELOG.md has an entry; README gives the local build command and the expected Pages URL, and notes the owner must set Pages source to GitHub Actions.
criteria.evidence: docs/design/explainer-site.md has an alternatives table and a Deferred section. CHANGELOG has an Added entry. The README section gives the build command and the URL https://<owner>.github.io/<repository>/, and says to set Settings → Pages → Source to GitHub Actions.

criteria.evidence: The command finished and printed 'wrote .../site/index.html'. `git status --porcelain` printed nothing afterward.

criteria.evidence: `cargo test -p xtask`: 9+9 passed. summary: The change adds a Rust command, `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, that renders one self-contained `site/index.html` from studies/firstmate-work-handling. It also adds a new `.github/workflows/pages.yml` that builds the page and deploys it to GitHub Pages, plus the README section, changelog entry and design note. I ran the site command: it exits 0, writes site/index.html, and `git status` stays clean. The page states pinned commit 6407052f… and loads no scripts, external stylesheets or external links. The xtask tests passed (9 unit and 9 policy tests). The 5 new renderer tests cover escaping, claim-id citation, an unknown claim id and missing data. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` were clean. ci.yml, athena.toml, defaults.toml, rust-toolchain.toml, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are unchanged. There are three minor findings. (1) docs/non-rust-files.md was changed but is not on the expected deliverables list; the edit is a needed companion to the policy-test list. (2) The Pages actions are pinned by version tag, not commit SHA as ci.yml does; the design note records this as deferred. (3) The study's findings section cites finding ids, not claim ids, but the page labels them as findings about the study, not claims about firstmate. The live URL and enabling Pages are owner actions and out of scope.
